# 2_extracted_text

Text pulled out of the documents in `1_source_documents/`: every line, with its page and position, so every rule can point back to its exact spot. Format: see `packages/document_extraction/README.md`.

**Generated by code only. Never hand-edit.** To change it, fix the extraction code and re-run `python -m document_extraction`. CI fails if these files don't match a fresh extraction.

**Contents list** (`<book>.contents.jsonl`, generated: `python -m document_extraction contents <this law's folder>`, `--check` to compare): every chapter (article) and section of the chapter with its title as printed, its printed page and the PDF page and line it was read from (the articles' headings in the extracted text and the sections file's sections), so a results panel can show the whole chapter, greyed where Gordium has no rules. Never hand-edit. How: `packages/document_extraction/document_extraction/contents.py`.
